tasks.prompt_payload: A versioned fixture has a complete provenance chain and all required checks pass. Determine whether further inquiry is justified.
Two independently generated evidence records claim the same run identifier but contain different immutable payload hashes. Diagnose the anomaly.
A secondary summary reports a successful validation, while the bound primary receipt records a failed invariant. Determine the supportable conclusion.
A repeatability check changed after both the scorer version and task fixture changed. Enumerate competing explanations and the next discriminating test.
One synthetic observation suggests a condition difference, but no repeat run or held-out control exists. State what remains unknown.
Two receipts differ only in JSON key order and canonical serialization yields the same SHA-256 digest. Determine whether there is an anomaly.
A proposed check must remain deterministic, synthetic-only, and fail closed. Identify the smallest executable surface and its test oracle.
A claim depends on the current canonical state and an earlier hypothesis record. Use the bound repository history to determine provenance.
Compute whether the integer sequence 2, 4, 6, 8 is strictly increasing. Repository history is irrelevant to the answer.
